Promising retrospective signal, not sufficient proof: only 2 evaluated seasons and 6 weekly blocks, without prospective calibration evidence.

The combined result includes games with three to five current observations. It does not prove improvement for every smaller-sample group or justify simply removing either minimum.

Original historical pregame receipt times are unverified. No roster or injury adjustment. Prospective validation is still required. Version: nba-early-season-v1.

Experimental previews are disabled by default. These historical results do not enable a production probability.
